title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has to be smarter with the football

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has to be smarter with the football
sources.description: The Titans had the ball inside the Giants' 10-yard-line with 24 seconds left in Sunday's game, but any hopes of a comeback win were dashed when quarterback Cam Ward's final pass left his hand.
